_readme: Shared fixtures for the TS-vs-Rust capture differential (E shard). Each scenario is a SEQUENCE of disk mutations driven to quiescence step by step; `offline` mutations happen with capture stopped and are reconciled by a fresh start. DISK-DRIVEN ONLY by design: TS writeIfChanged ignores metadata_origin (safe there because the desktop materializes API writes to disk), while the Rust shadow daemon enforces capture ownership — an approved behavioral delta, so RPC-vs-disk interleavings are covered by Rust-only acceptance tests instead. The goldens (capture-goldens.json) are emitted by apps/desktop/src/workspaces/captureOracleGoldens.test.ts (DOHC_EMIT_CAPTURE_GOLDENS=1) and verified by both that test and crates/dohc-workspace-engine/tests/capture_differential.rs. Ids and timestamps are deliberately excluded from projections; text/binary heads project sha256+byteLength(+text), secrets project byteLength only (goldens stay non-leaking); everTracked distinguishes retired from never-tracked (moments exist for the path). The text->binary content flip on one path is deferred: media-type routing precedes UTF-8 sniffing, so it needs its own sniffing-parity scenario set.
